scene: Inferno VIII — tower signals and Phlegyas answers
story: At a tower near Styx, two little flames appear
Dante asks what the signs mean; Virgil points to an approaching boat
Phlegyas pilots the boat swiftly toward the travelers
Phlegyas shouts an accusation; Virgil corrects his expectation
Virgil boards first, Dante follows, and the vessel sits more deeply in the water because Dante is alive
The boat heads across Styx toward Filippo Argenti and the walls of Dis
